_om: Dam in English (Draughts, rusj.no/en/draughts/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilen flytter nesten på måfå. Fint for: The phone moves almost at random. Good for learning the rules.
Mobilen slår når den kan, men ser ikke l: The phone captures when it can, but doesn't look far ahead. A nice first opponent.
Mobilen ser noen trekk fram og straffer: The phone looks a few moves ahead and punishes mistakes. A fair challenge.
Mobilen tenker dypt. Klarer du å slå den: The phone thinks hard. Can you beat it?
{navn}'s turn – a capture is a must.
Samme stilling tre ganger – remis!: The same position three times – it's a draw!
40 trekk uten slag – remis!: 40 moves without a capture – it's a draw!
Flere veier dit – trykk på ruta brikka s: More than one way there – first tap the square the piece should jump to
Fullfør slaget – brikka må slå videre: Finish the capture – the piece must keep jumping
Du må slå – bruk en av brikkene som blin: You must capture – use one of the flashing pieces
Denne brikka kan ikke flytte nå: This piece can't move right now
Du har {fa} med {na} brikker, Mobilen {f: You have {fa} with {na} pieces, the phone {fb} with {nb}.
Du vinner kampen – først til {n}!: You win the match – first to {n}!
Dam for to på samme mobil – eller mot mo: Draughts for two on the same phone – or against the phone at four levels. Capture all your opponent's pieces, or block them in, and you win. These are the Nordic rules: pieces can also capture backwards, and kings fly – a little different from English draughts.
Brikkene står på de mørke rutene og går: The pieces sit on the dark squares and move one square diagonally forwards. Tap a piece, then the square it should go to – or drag it there.
Står en av motstanderens brikker på skrå: If one of your opponent's pieces sits diagonally next to yours with an empty square behind it, jump over it and capture it – forwards or backwards. You must capture when you can, and if your piece can capture again, it must.
Ender en brikke på bakerste rad, blir de: A piece that ends its move on the far row is crowned king. A king moves as far as it likes diagonally. If you can't move, you've lost.
Kan flere brikker slå, velger du selv hv: If several pieces can capture, you choose which capture to make – but it must be finished. The pieces that can capture flash.
A piece can only be jumped once. Captured pieces come off the board when the whole capture is over.
Damen slår på avstand: over én brikke på: A king captures from a distance: over one piece on the same diagonal, with only empty squares in between, landing on any empty square beyond it.
Passerer en vanlig brikke bakerste rad m: If an ordinary piece passes the far row in the middle of a capture and keeps capturing, it isn't crowned. It only becomes a king when its move ends there.
Remis (uavgjort): samme stilling for tre: A draw: the same position for the third time, or 40 moves in a row (20 each) with no capture and no ordinary piece moving.
Hvit begynner, og dere bytter på å begyn: White starts, and you take turns to start each round. First to 3: whoever wins three games first wins the match.
Mot mobilen på nybegynner og lett foresl: Against the phone on Beginner and Easy, ‘Hint’ suggests a move. Tapped the wrong square? ‘Undo’ takes the move back.
Kom deg fram og bli dame!: Reach the far side and be crowned!
Hvordan vil du spille?: How do you want to play?
Whoever starts has the white pieces. You and the phone take turns to start each round.
Whoever starts has the white pieces. You take turns to start each round.
One game – whoever wins it, wins.
Den som først vinner {n} partier, vinner: Whoever wins {n} games first wins the match.
Dere spiller så mange partier dere vil,: Play as many games as you like, and stop whenever you like.
Den som skal flytte, har alltid sine bri: Whoever is moving always has their pieces at the bottom.
Godt kjempa! Prøv igjen – eller velg et: Well fought! Try again – or pick an easier level.
Like mange seirer hver. Det får avgjøres: The same number of wins each. It'll have to be settled next time!
Vent litt – mobilen tenker: Hang on – the phone is thinking
Dere går til kåringen. Stillingen er {st: You'll go to the results. The score is {stilling}. A game that isn't finished doesn't count.
Partiet som er i gang, teller ikke. Dere: The game in progress won't count. You can always start a new one.
